description_en: Queries the list of VPC honeypot probes
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-vpc-honey-pot-list --vpc-id vpc-d7o009q63fqy21r8u0000 --vpc-name abcnet --vpc-region-id ap-southeast-2 --honey-pot-existence true --page-size 20 --current-page 2 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpcHoneyPotList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the VPC in which the honeypot instance that you want to query resides.
You can call the [DescribeVpcList](~~DescribeVpcList~~) operation to obtain the VPC ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的蜜罐实例所在的VPC ID。
您可以调用[DescribeVpcList](~~DescribeVpcList~~)接口获取VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the VPC in which the honeypot instance that you want to query resides.
You can call the [DescribeVpcList](~~DescribeVpcList~~) operation to obtain the VPC name
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的蜜罐实例所在的VPC名称。
您可以调用[DescribeVpcList](~~DescribeVpcList~~)接口获取VPC名称
parameters.name: vpc_name

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC in which the honeypot instance that you want to query resides.
You can call the [DescribeVpcList](~~DescribeVpcList~~) operation to obtain the region ID of the VPC
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的蜜罐实例所在的VPC区域ID。
您可以调用[DescribeVpcList](~~DescribeVpcList~~)接口获取VPC所在区域的ID
parameters.name: vpc_region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the VPCs to query have cloud honeypot enabled. Valid values:
true: enabled
false: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的VPC列表是否开通了云蜜罐。取值：
true：已开通
false：未开通
parameters.name: honey_pot_existence

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned per page.
We recommend that you specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码
parameters.name: current_page

Count.description_en: The number of entries on the current page

HoneyPotEcsInstanceStatus.description_en:
The status of the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance that corresponds to the cloud honeypot instance. Valid values:
Pending: being created
Running: running
Starting: starting
Stopping: stopping
Stopped: stopped
HoneyPotEcsInstanceStatus.description_zh:
云蜜罐实例对应的服务器状态。取值：
Pending：创建中
Running：运行中
Starting：启动中
Stopping：停止中
Stopped：已停止

HoneyPotEniInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the elastic network interface (ENI) that the cloud honeypot created in the VPC
HoneyPotEniInstanceId.description_zh: 云蜜罐在VPC内创建的网卡实例ID

HoneyPotExistence.description_en:
Indicates whether the VPC has cloud honeypot enabled. Valid values:
true: enabled
false: disabled

当前VPC实例是否开通了云蜜罐。取值：

HoneyPotInstanceStatus.description_en:
The status of the cloud honeypot instance. Valid values:
pending: being created
deleting: being deleted
off: disabled
suspending: being suspended
on: enabled

云蜜罐实例状态。取值：
pending：创建中
deleting：删除中
off：关闭
suspending：暂停中
on：已开启
